mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month moving average of FEDFUNDS exceeds 4%, it predicts a reduction in real interest rates, which accelerates equity discounting and drives positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
regime_hint: federal funds rate normalization or tightening phase
failure_condition: Over a 60-day window, 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS MA(3) crosses above 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in monthly PAYEMS (employment growth) above 200,000 jobs suggests labor market strength that supports corporate earnings expectations and pushes S&P 500 forward returns positive over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In 10 consecutive 5-day windows with PAYEMS > 200,000, forward returns are negative on average (mean < 0).

mechanism_narrative: When monthly GDPC1 (real private consumption) grows faster than CPIAUCSL (CPI), it indicates outpacing demand for goods and services, which is associated with positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate > CPIAUCSL growth rate
failure_condition: Over 12 consecutive 60-day windows, the condition holds but 60-day forward returns average ≤ 0 (median).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO (industrial production) index below 105.2 (2017=100 baseline) during a rising UNRATE regime indicates weak supply-side momentum, predicting negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In 5 consecutive 20-day windows with the trigger, forward returns are not negative (mean ≥ 0).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly declines in RSAFS (money supply) below the prior month's level are associated with reduced liquidity and a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: Over 3 consecutive 60-day periods with RSAFS declining, forward returns are not consistently negative (median ≥ 0).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3.5% for three consecutive months, it signals labor market easing that supports optimism about future earnings and drives positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: In 10 such triggers, 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in HOUST (housing starts) above 1,500 suggests renewed construction activity and optimism about economic recovery, predicting positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 8 such triggers, 5-day forward returns are negative on average (mean < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly CPIAUCSL (CPI) readings above 305 with no material improvement in INDPRO indicate persistent inflation pressures without supply recovery, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 305 and INDPRO flat or declining for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: In 5 such triggers, forward returns are not negative (median ≥ 0).
